BUSINESS STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #15
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: BUSINESS STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Entrepreneurship is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Entrepreneurship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Entrepreneurship as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Entrepreneurship.
   D. Say Entrepreneurship never happens in Kenya.

2. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Avoiding all community work
   B. Littering in markets
   C. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   D. Destroying road signs

3. Which statement about Types of Business Ownership is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Types of Business Ownership as rumours only.
   B. Explain Types of Business Ownership with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Types of Business Ownership never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Types of Business Ownership.

4. Which statement about Networking in Business is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Networking in Business as rumours only.
   B. Explain Networking in Business with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Networking in Business never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Networking in Business.

5. Which statement about Marketing is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Marketing as rumours only.
   B. Say Marketing never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Marketing.
   D. Explain Marketing with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

6. Which statement about Income Statement is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Income Statement as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Income Statement.
   C. Say Income Statement never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Income Statement with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

7. Which statement about End - Of - Year Adjustments is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing End - Of - Year Adjustments.
   B. Treat End - Of - Year Adjustments as rumours only.
   C. Say End - Of - Year Adjustments never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain End - Of - Year Adjustments with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

8. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Kisumu
   B. Nairobi
   C. Mombasa
   D. Nakuru

9. Which statement about Foreign Exchange Markets is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Foreign Exchange Markets.
   B. Treat Foreign Exchange Markets as rumours only.
   C. Explain Foreign Exchange Markets with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Foreign Exchange Markets never happens in Kenya.

10. Which statement about Public Finance is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Public Finance as rumours only.
   B. Explain Public Finance with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Public Finance.
   D. Say Public Finance never happens in Kenya.

11. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Measure rainfall only
   B. Explain symbols used on a map
   C. Replace the compass rose
   D. Name the president

12. Which statement about Money Markets is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Money Markets with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Money Markets as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Money Markets.
   D. Say Money Markets never happens in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Insurance and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Foreign Exchange Markets and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Money Markets and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Public Finance and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
